label: Conservative
description: Small positions, tight stops, daily loss cap enforced, human approval required.
summaryBullets: Max position $200, stop loss 2%, daily loss limit $100.
Human approval required for every trade.
Confidence threshold set high — wait for strong signals.

howToEvaluate: Be conservative about conflicts, weak evidence, and unresolved risks.
Prefer passing on marginal setups instead of stretching for activity.

avoid: Do not treat medium-quality evidence as good enough just because a trade is available.

label: Moderate
description: Balanced position sizing, trailing stops, approval optional.

howToEvaluate: Favor balanced evidence and usable trade quality instead of either ultra-conservative filtering or reckless chasing.

label: Aggressive
description: Larger positions, wider stops, maximum concurrent exposure.
summaryBullets: Max position $1000, wider stops allow trades to breathe.
Daily loss limit $500, higher profit targets.
Up to 5 concurrent trades, no mandatory human approval.

howToEvaluate: You can accept more volatility and uncertainty than conservative presets, but only when the edge is still coherent.

whatToLookFor: Higher-upside opportunities where wider risk tolerance is actually being used for a reason, not just to excuse weak setups.

label: Prediction Market
description: Kelly-sized positions for event contracts, probability-edge focused.
summaryBullets: Kelly fraction 0.25, max exposure $2000 across open contracts.
Prediction edge threshold 8% — only trade mispriced odds.
Market resolution exits — no fixed stop loss.

howToEvaluate: Focus on probability edge, resolution mechanics, and whether the evidence justifies a contract-based position.

label: Custom Risk
description: No preset assumptions — configure all risk fields manually.
summaryBullets: Use when no built-in preset fits your session.

howToEvaluate: Use the live risk fields directly rather than assuming any built-in tolerance profile.
